newsitem.title: USA: Homeland Holding stake held by Soros group.
newsitem.headline: Homeland Holding stake held by Soros group.

text.p: A group led by U.S. investor George Soros said Tuesday it holds a 10.01 percent stake in Homeland Holding Corp or 476,043 common shares.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions include the purchase of 290,468 common shares between May 22 and June 11 at prices ranging from $6.65 to $7.05 per share.
The group said it holds the stake for investment purposes.
Homeland, based in Oklahoma City, is a supermarket chain in Oklahoma, southern Kansas and the Texas panhandle.
